title: Feature across several files (due dates + tags in a CLI)
prompt: This repo is a small command-line task tracker (package `tracker/`). Implement the feature described in FEATURE.md (due dates, tags, filters, sorting, and a version-2 storage format that still loads old files). Keep all existing behaviour working. Run the tests with `python -m pytest -q`; the visible tests cover only part of FEATURE.md, so check every rule yourself. When you are done, stop.
